title: How well do you know your summarization datasets?

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying summarization dataset samples into a six-class typology based on noise and complexity (e.g., Extractive, Paraphrase, Inference), and analyzing how automatic evaluation metrics (such as ROUGE, BERTScore, and MoverScore) score and correlate with human judgment across these different complexity classes to reveal a bias toward simpler, extractive references.
